**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: automatic mode

> [!NOTE] > ## Reviews paused > > It looks like this branch is under active development. To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review ## Walkthrough Update test diagnostics in egress firewall test to run nslookup and two verbose curl probes (including resolved IP + HTTP code) for redhat.com/www.redhat.com, modify assertions; and extend test YAMLs to include explicit IPv4 and IPv6 deny-all CIDRs. ## Changes **Egress firewall test + testdata** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**DNS probe**
`test/extended/networking/egress_firewall.go`|Adds `nslookup` for `redhat.com` and `www.redhat.com`, logging resolution output or failure.| |**Verbose connection diagnostics**
`test/extended/networking/egress_firewall.go`|Replaces quiet `curl -s` with `curl -v --connect-timeout 3`, capturing verbose connection logs per domain.| |**Resolved IP + HTTP code probe**
`test/extended/networking/egress_firewall.go`|Adds a second `curl` using `-w '%{remote_ip} %{http_code}'` to record remote IP and HTTP status for each domain.| |**Assertion updates**
`test/extended/networking/egress_firewall.go`|Changes expectations to `expectNoError` for `redhat.com` and `expectError` for `www.redhat.com`, using the new diagnostic outputs.| |**Testdata: explicit IPv4 and IPv6 deny-all CIDRs**
`test/extended/testdata/egress-firewall/ovnk-egressfirewall-test.yaml`, `test/extended/testdata/egress-firewall/ovnk-egressfirewall-wildcard-test.yaml`|Replaces the prior single deny entry with explicit `cidrSelector: 0.0.0.0/0` (IPv4) and adds `cidrSelector: ::/0` (IPv6) deny entries (inline comments added).| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes --- > [!CAUTION] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. > > - [ ] Ignore ### ❌ Failed checks (1 error, 4 warnings) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :----------------------------------------------: | :--------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ❌ Error | Test step names (By statements) contain "Shreyas-" prefix on lines 163, 207, 232 of egress_firewall.go. These are debugging artifacts that make test names non-deterministic and not production-ready. | Remove "Shreyas-" prefix from all By() statements. Replace with stable, descriptive names without the author prefix. | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 0.00% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | Debug code remains in test (Shreyas markers/comments), inconsistent assertion messages, inline cleanup instead of BeforeEach/AfterEach, multiple unrelated behaviors tested in single function. | Remove Shreyas debug markers/comments, add messages to all assertions, use BeforeEach/AfterEach for setup/cleanup, split sendEgressFwTraffic into focused scenarios. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | Test "egressFirewall should have no impact outside..." is not protected from running on MicroShift. It queries configv1.Infrastructure which is not available on MicroShift. | Wrap the test in InOVNKubernetesContext(), add [apigroup:config.openshift.io] tag, or add IsMicroShiftCluster() guard with g.Skip(). | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | Test requires external internet connectivity (redhat.com, google.com, amazon.com), which fails in disconnected IPv6 environments. Has runtime skip but lacks [Skipped:Disconnected]. | Add [Skipped:Disconnected] to test names: 'should ensure egressfirewall is created [Skipped:Disconnected]' and 'should ensure egressfirewall with wildcard dns rules is created [Skipped:Disconnected]'. |
